name: OpenAI GPT3 Augmentor
description: Provides an Augmentor plugin that sends text to the OpenAI completions API to summarize, rewrite, classify or otherwise transform it.
project_description: Augmentor OpenAI GPT3 is an Augmentor sub-project that registers a single Augmentor plugin (openai_gpt3_completions) which passes text through the OpenAI completions API. It plugs into the Augmentor framework's key/plugin infrastructure, resolves its OpenAI API key from a Key entity, and can drive either the orhanerday/open-ai or the openai-php/client PHP SDK. Beyond a straight completion it offers an optional chunk-and-summarize pass for inputs longer than the model context, plus the full set of OpenAI completion parameters (model, temperature, max_tokens, top_p, n, best_of, penalties, stop, logit_bias, etc.). It ships no routes, permissions, services (other than the help hook), config entities or schema of its own — configuration lives inside an Augmentor config entity administered through the base module's UI.
